verses.10: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
verses.11: We are all one man's sons; we are true men, thy servants are no spies.
verses.12: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
verses.13: And they said, Thy servants are twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of
verses.15: Hereby ye shall be proved: By the life of Pharaoh ye shall not go forth hence, except your youngest brother come hither.
verses.16: Send one of you, and let him fetch your brother, and ye shall be kept in prison, that your words may be proved, whether there be any truth in you: or else by the life of Pharaoh surely ye are spies.
verses.17: And he put them all together into ward three days.
verses.19: If ye be true men, let one of your brethren be bound in the house of your prison: go ye, carry corn for the famine of your houses:
verses.20: But bring your youngest brother unto me; so shall your words be verified, and ye shall not die. And they did so.
verses.21: And they said one to another, We are verily guilty concerning our brother, in that we saw the anguish of his soul, when he besought us, and we would not hear; therefore is this distress come upon us.
verses.24: And he turned himself about from them, and wept; and returned to them again, and communed with them, and took from them
verses.26: And they laded their asses with the corn, and departed thence.
verses.27: And as one of them opened his sack to give his ass provender in the inn, he espied his money; for, behold, it was in his sack's mouth.
verses.28: And he said unto his brethren, My money is restored; and, lo, it is even in my sack: and their heart failed them, and they were afraid, saying one to another, What is this that God hath done unto us?
verses.30: The man, who is the lord of the land, spake roughly to us, and took us for spies of the country.
verses.31: And we said unto him, We are true men; we are no spies:
verses.32: We be twelve brethren, sons of our father; one is not, and the youngest is this day with our father in the land of
verses.33: And the man, the lord of the country, said unto us, Hereby shall I know that ye are true men; leave one of your brethren here with me, and take food for the famine of your households, and be gone:
verses.34: And bring your youngest brother unto me: then shall I know that ye are no spies, but that ye are true men: so will I deliver you your brother, and ye shall traffick in the land.
verses.35: And it came to pass as they emptied their sacks, that, behold, every man's bundle of money was in his sack: and when both they and their father saw the bundles of money, they were afraid.
verses.38: And he said, My son shall not go down with you; for his brother is dead, and he is left alone: if mischief befall him by the way in the which ye go, then shall ye bring down my gray hairs with sorrow to the grave.
